judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the planning/test-writing phase and never implemented the actual production code changes. While it updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and added an acceptance test in `src/orchestration/usage.acceptance.test.ts` (along with an internal `.lore/dod.md` file), `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` and `CHANGELOG.md` are completely untouched. As a result, the orchestrator still overwrites `lastUsage` instead of accumulating `totalUsage`, the hook parameter name in `OrchestratorHooks` is unchanged, the changelog entry is missing, and the newly added test will fail.
